result.title: TransFIRA+: Transfer Learning for Biometric Recognizability Assessment
result.summary: Biometric recognition in surveillance, video, and web imagery must contend with extreme variation in pose, blur, illumination, occlusion, and distance, where visual quality metrics fail to predict whether inputs are recognizable to the deployed encoder. Existing face image quality assessment methods rely on visual heuristics, curated annotations, or costly generative pipelines, leaving their predictions detached from the encoder's decision geometry. We introduce TransFIRA, a lightweight framework that grounds recognizability directly in embedding space. TransFIRA derives class-center similarity (CCS) and class-center angular separation (CCAS) from a pretrained encoder's embeddings and learns to predict them from images without quality annotations. Using predicted CCS for template weighting and CCAS>0 as a natural filtering threshold yields state-of-the-art face verification performance on BRIAR, raising TAR at $10^{-6}$ FMR from 0.085 with uniform averaging to 0.598. The predicted scores also reveal how image degradations affect encoder-specific recognizability. TransFIRA+ extends this framework to cross-camera multimodal person identification in untrimmed surveillance video. In this setting, body recognizability scores saturate within a narrow range, making direct weighting effectively uniform. We introduce a post-hoc sigmoid calibration that transforms these saturated scores into informative weights without retraining. After calibration, the BRIAR-trained TransFIRA predictor improves fused face and body identification on two unseen multi-camera datasets, outperforming detector-confidence weighting and uncalibrated CCS-rank weighting. Together, TransFIRA and TransFIRA+ demonstrate that encoder-grounded recognizability generalizes across biometric modalities and recognition settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TransFIRA：无需质量标注，从预训练编码器嵌入导出类中心相似度 CCS 与类中心角间隔 CCAS，学习由图像直接预测，并用 CCS 加权、CCAS>0 作为过滤阈值；TransFIRA+ 以事后 sigmoid 校准把饱和的身体可识别性分数转为有效权重，扩展到跨摄像头人脸与身体联合识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 用轻量预测器估计「输入对当前编码器是否可辨识」，并以嵌入几何阈值筛选证据，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与视觉旁路权重提供可核查线索，但面向生物识别质量评估，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关联。
